title: Eye-tracking font size, serif status, and reading
statement:
Eye-tracking research on online reading found that smaller fonts produced longer visual fixations and somewhat slower reading, while serif versus sans-serif differences were not statistically significant, supporting a preference for adequately sized type over a typography rule based solely on serif status.

Options:
- Compact body: 16px (fits: compact, professional)
- Comfortable body: 18px (fits: comfortable, editorial)
- Large body: 20px (fits: friendly, access-first)
- Reading-first: 22px (fits: minimal, editorial)
appliesWhen: Applies to: general web, web apps, content sites. Audience: adults, general.
